_doc: Numbers the game files do NOT contain. Each entry is used by the engine and is surfaced in the UI/API next to any result that depends on it. Replace a value only with a better-sourced one and update status/source.

rare_mod_count.applies_to: Chaos Orb, Orb of Alchemy, Essences: number of explicit mods on a non-jewel rare
rare_mod_count.source: Long-standing community data-collection results, also the default model used by Craft of Exile. Not published by GGG.

rare_jewel_mod_count.applies_to: Rare jewels / abyss jewels (max 2 prefixes + 2 suffixes)
rare_jewel_mod_count.source: No reliable source found yet. 50/50 placeholder; results depending on it are flagged.

magic_mod_count.applies_to: Orb of Transmutation, Orb of Alteration: 1 or 2 mods on a magic item
magic_mod_count.source: No reliable source found yet. 50/50 placeholder; results depending on it are flagged.

harvest_same_type_multiplier.applies_to: Harvest 'Reforge a Rare item, being more likely to receive the same modifier types': weight multiplier for mod types already on the item
harvest_same_type_multiplier.source: Craft of Exile FAQ (craftofexile.com/faq, read 2026-11-26): 'reported to me' as datamined in Harvest league (3.11, 2020), removed from the game files since. Not confirmed for 3.30.

harvest_same_type_keeps_mod_count.applies_to: Same Harvest craft: the item never rolls fewer mods than it had
harvest_same_type_keeps_mod_count.source: Craft of Exile FAQ (read 2026-11-26), same caveat as harvest_same_type_multiplier.

fracture_excludes_crafted.applies_to: Fracturing Orb: crafted modifiers are not candidates (explicit, non-crafted mods only)
fracture_excludes_crafted.source: poedb.tw/us/Fracturing_Orb says only 'a random modifier' on a rare with at least 4 modifiers, not on influenced or fractured items. Whether crafted mods can be picked is not stated.
